description: Transportschaarste (Beschikbare capaciteit elektriciteitsnet) is a dataset listed in Dutch national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by DONL Dataregister. In delen van ons verzorgingsgebied is de maximale capaciteit van het elektriciteitsnet bereikt of in zicht. Daar kan het gebeuren dat grootzakelijke klanten minder mogelijkheden krijgen om extra vermogen te gebruiken voor afnemen of terugleveren van elektriciteit. Op deze pagina is de beschikbaarheid van de capaciteit per gebied in beeld gebracht. Coverage: the Netherlands. The portal files it under the publisher DONL Dataregister. Its tags are Elektriciteit, Energie, Liander, Transportschaarste. It offers 1 resource(s) in HTTP://PUBLICATIONS.EUROPA.EU/RESOURCE/AUTHORITY/FILE-TYPE/HTML. The portal shows 2022-12-12 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-nl-portal.
